# apcore

> A schema-enforced module standard for the AI-Perceivable era: define a module once and have it invoked deterministically by code or by AI agents over MCP and A2A.

apcore is the perception layer of the AI-Perceivable ecosystem. It constrains how agents call modules (schema + behavior annotations) to eliminate hallucinated tool calls, and verifies a single contract across Python, TypeScript, and Rust instead of hand-syncing it.

## Start Here

- [Project Overview](https://apcore.aiperceivable.com/): What apcore is, the problem it solves, and the "build once, invoke by code or AI" model.
- [Core Concepts](https://apcore.aiperceivable.com/concepts/): Modules, schemas, behavior annotations, context, and the executor — the mental model behind apcore.
- [Getting Started](https://apcore.aiperceivable.com/getting-started/): Install apcore and expose your first schema-enforced, AI-perceivable module in a few minutes.
- [Glossary](https://apcore.aiperceivable.com/glossary/): Definitions of core terms used across the apcore ecosystem.

## Features

- [Features Overview](https://apcore.aiperceivable.com/features/): Catalog of apcore's protocols, execution, security, and ops capabilities.
- [Module Interface](https://apcore.aiperceivable.com/features/module-interface/): The contract every apcore module implements and how it is discovered.
- [APCore Client](https://apcore.aiperceivable.com/features/apcore-client/): Invoking modules programmatically with deterministic, schema-validated calls.
- [Schema System](https://apcore.aiperceivable.com/features/schema-system/): How schemas are defined, validated, and enforced at the call boundary.
- [ACL System](https://apcore.aiperceivable.com/features/acl-system/): Access control governing which callers may invoke which modules.
- [Observability](https://apcore.aiperceivable.com/features/observability/): Tracing, logging, and metrics for module execution.

## Specifications

- [Framework Specs](https://apcore.aiperceivable.com/spec/): Authoritative protocol and framework specifications for apcore.

## Ecosystem

- [apcore-mcp](https://apcore-mcp.aiperceivable.com/): MCP server & OpenAI tools bridge for apcore modules.
- [apcore-a2a](https://apcore-a2a.aiperceivable.com/): Agent-to-Agent (A2A) protocol adapter.
- [apcore-cli](https://apcore-cli.aiperceivable.com/): Expose apcore modules as command-line tools.
- [apcore-toolkit](https://apcore-toolkit.aiperceivable.com/): Shared scanner, schema extraction, and output toolkit for adapters.
- [apflow](https://apflow.aiperceivable.com/): Orchestration layer for long-running, multi-step agent task workflows.
- [AI Perceivable (ecosystem hub)](https://aiperceivable.com/): Overview of the full ecosystem — apcore (perception), apflow (orchestration), and adapters.

## Key Facts

- apcore is the core/perception layer of the AI-Perceivable ecosystem.
- Module standard with schema enforcement and behavior annotations for deterministic agent invocation.
- Multi-language: Python, TypeScript, and Rust with a single verified contract.
- Exposed over MCP, A2A, and a CLI via dedicated adapters (apcore-mcp, apcore-a2a, apcore-cli).
- Open source. Source: https://github.com/aiperceivable/apcore
